preconditions.description: The number of queries t is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The order of the graph n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a and a != b and b <= 10**16 for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, vertices a and b are distinct positive integers up to 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(a <= size_D(n) and b <= size_D(n) for a, b in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, both vertices are within the valid range of the graph D(n), where size_D(n) is the number of vertices in D(n).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == shortest_path_length(queries[i][0], queries[i][1], n) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line i contains the length of the shortest path between the vertices specified in the i-th query within the graph D(n).
